notes_for_editor: Thin record. The tnlandforms.us list (GA333) is the only source placing this site; it gives county, coordinates and an unlabelled elevation of 124, which matches the record's 37.8 m if read as feet. The name 'arcola' is the list author's own. The row carries no BLL or other code. No Georgia NHLR page for this site is in the local cache. Status and access stay unknown: no source says. The 1948 statewide report is context only, not evidence about this tower.
